title: Beach Music | KEY.co
description_expanded: - Seagrove is one of the charming coastal communities that sits on 30A nestled between Seaside Beach and Watersound, it offers an array of public beach accesses and great restaurants like Surfing Deer and Market Cafe. You'll find restaurants and shops within walking distance, and a quick bike ride west will land you in Seaside, a well-known 30A spot with farmers markets, shops, restaurants, and local food trucks to fill your entire party's needs. Take a quick bike ride east and you can find yourself at The Big Chill, a popular outdoor space filled with restaurants, outdoor games, and big screen TVs to watch any sporting event your heart desires. 30A is located in between the beach and a 15,000-acre forest that is filled with hiking trails and off-road trails, for those that want to skip the beach or want a different experience. This stunning multi-level beach home on the south side of 30A in Seagrove combines luxurious amenities with the relaxed charm of coastal living. Steps from the sugar-white sands and emerald waters, this property is perfectly suited for large groups or families seeking both comfort and style. With two spacious living rooms and kitchens, the home provides a flexible layout ideal for gathering and entertaining. Outside, a heated pool and inviting entertainment area create a private retreat, while thoughtful touches like six bikes and a golf cart make exploring the surrounding coastal gems a breeze.
